Careening down the cobbled hill street, a buttercup-yellow sledge sends a rooster-tail of powder off its left runner, the tiny painted sledder leaning hard into the curve, a toppled milk churn spinning in the wake behind, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Swinging out over ink-dark water, the lighthouse beam catches the spray mid-air, thousands of lit droplets hanging in it, the painted keeper a grain-of-rice silhouette in the lamp-room doorway, the rocks below still silvered where the light has just passed.

Bursting off the snow-buried rooftop in a copper-and-charcoal explosion, forty painted starlings scatter upward, the lowest birds still in tight formation, the highest already breaking apart like thrown pepper against the violet sky.

Leaning back on the hempen rope with the great verdigris bell already tipped well past its balance point, a tiny painted bellringer plants both heels on the flagstone, the rope's arc still curved above the empty belfry.

Skidding on black ice with one scarlet-booted foot stamped hard to the ground, a painted postie fights the handlebars of a holly-green bicycle, the canvas satchel swinging wide, three envelopes mid-tumble from its open flap, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Winding up the lantern-lit hill with the front of the procession already curling round the granite bend, a straggling file of painted carol singers clutches crimson candles, the last two figures still stepping off the cobbled square below.

Halfway up a soot-blackened ladder propped against a honey-brick chimney, a painted sweep in a peacock-teal coat reaches for the next rung, the dropped brush spinning handle-first toward the snow three storeys beneath.

Tilting into a hard left turn on the hill road, a lacquered scarlet sleigh kicks twin arcs of ice-crystal off its gilded runners, the tiny painted driver hauling the reins, the horses' hoof-prints still scored in a long curve behind, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Half-inflated and straining against its rope tethers, a tangerine balloon envelope billows into the pewter sky, two painted balloonists in indigo coats hauling the burner chain, the wicker basket still tilted sideways on the frozen grass, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Cresting the amber dune with the caravan's carved roof catching the last copper light, a painted driver in a saffron headscarf urges two tiny painted horses forward, the deep wheel-ruts still fresh and dark in the sand below, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Mid-stride on the oval pond with a long curved silver scratch stretching behind his blade, a painted skater in a claret coat leans into the next stroke, arms wide, a dropped amber scarf still uncoiling on the ice behind him.

Lifting off a warm terracotta chimney on wings the colour of old bronze, a dragon the size of a painted cat arches its back mid-launch, three loose roof-tiles rocking in its wake, one still balanced at the chimney's lip.

Punching through the near tunnel-mouth with its amber windows blazing against the soot-black brickwork, a painted train trails a white steam plume that hangs in a long curve back across the viaduct it has just crossed, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Spinning with one gilded car cresting the apex, a painted ferris wheel catches the last rose light on its spokes, the tiny painted rider in the high car leaning out, a dropped cobalt scarf still falling toward the fairground below.

Mid-spin, a carousel of crimson horses blurs past the painted ticket booth, one tiny painted rider leaning forward with arm outstretched, fingertips nearly brushing the brass ring swinging on its post at the edge of the platform.

Propping the bottle-green shutter open with a wide timber tray still steaming in one hand, a painted baker in a flour-white apron wedges a boot against the sill, three golden loaves tilting on the tray's far corner.

Caught in the air six inches above the painted retriever's nose, a pine-green stick tumbles end over end, the tiny painted dog mid-leap beneath it, paws off the snow, its own footprints ending abruptly at the launch point.

Whipping off the line in a gust, a sheet of ox-blood red cloth snaps horizontal above the rooftop, two wooden pegs already bouncing down the tiles, the remaining washing still pinned and flailing in the same hard wind.

Banging against the stone wall on its iron hinge, a cobalt shutter swings fully open in mid-gust, the latch dangling free, a painted pot of dried herbs on the sill inside teetering at the edge it has clearly just slid to.

Arriving through the harbour gap with its rust-orange hull trailing a white V-wake still spreading across the grey water, a painted fishing boat leans slightly to starboard, the tiny painted deckhand already coiling a rope at the bow, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Frozen mid-tumble at the bottom of the toboggan run in a tangle of lime-green and violet sleds, three painted figures sprawl in the churned snow, one sled still spinning on its side, a knitted hat pinwheeling in the cold air above, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Hanging a tin lantern on the outermost branch of a snow-laden fir, a tiny painted figure in a vermillion coat stretches on tiptoe, the lit lantern already swinging, a warm amber circle spreading on the snow below.

Half-swung across the lane with its candy-stripe boom still moving, a level-crossing gate catches a painted stationmaster mid-crank, the tiny handle still turning, the gate's far end still two feet short of the post it is aiming for.

Pushed off the ice with a long pole, a butter-yellow rowboat tilts at the moment of launch, a painted deckhand in a jade coat leaning on the pole, the dark water already opening in a thin line behind the hull, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted colour wearing a single small painted picture.

Thrown from a painted carol singer's mitten and caught in perfect stillness three inches from the nose of a laughing painted figure across the ring, a dense white snowball hangs in the lamplight, its shadow already on the cobblestones below.
Swings a buttercup-yellow sledge mid-run down the cobbled street, a painted sledder leaning hard left, a long twin groove scratched into the snow behind, a toppled milk-churn rolling in the wake.
Skids a painted postie's bicycle on black ice, one booted foot stamped down, the rear wheel spraying a fan of slush, a scattered arc of crimson-banded parcels already settling in the snow behind.

Turns a lacquered ox-blood-red sleigh mid-corner on the hill road, a painted driver hauling the reins, snow kicking off the brass-trimmed runners in a bright white curl, the uphill track still pressed with fresh grooves.
Catches a packed snowball in the air between two tiny painted figures, the thrower's arm still extended, a dent in the pine-green garden hedge where the last one landed a half-second before.
Strides a painted skater mid-glide across bottle-green ice, one blade lifted, a long curved scratch arcing behind, a dropped tangerine-orange scarf still unwinding across the surface ahead.

Winds a lit procession of painted carol singers up the hill road, their amber lanterns swinging, the front of the column already bent around the granite corner, the tail still passing the painted baker's doorstep.

Rings a painted bellringer leaning hard on a fraying indigo rope, the great bronze bell already tipped past vertical above the tower arch, the rope's lower end snapping taut against the flagstone floor below.

Sweeps a painted chimney sweep halfway up a soot-black ladder propped against a terracotta chimney stack, one boot on the rung, the bristle-brush already above the pot, the discarded canvas bag splayed open on the snow below.

Launches a painted balloon crew mid-inflation, the crimson-and-gold envelope half-bellied with hot air and listing ten degrees, the wicker basket still resting on the cobbles with two painted figures bracing its rim.
Crashes a toboggan pile-up at the lane's foot: three painted figures in a tangle of limbs, a cobalt-blue toboggan upended, a second still sliding in from the left trailing a broken rope.

Swings a lighthouse beam out over the pewter-dark water, the white arc catching a spray of foam mid-burst against the far rocks, the lamp's previous sweep still glowing faintly on the wet stone behind.

Comes a deep-sea-blue fishing boat in from the harbour mouth, its wake spreading in two long silver arcs, a painted fisherman at the stern with a rope coiled ready, its hull and flanks one plain block of painted blue wearing a single small painted fish.

Pushes a painted oarsman off the ice shelf with a long pole, the flat-bottomed rowboat's prow already over open black water, a cracked plate of ice rocking in the gap behind, its hull one plain block of painted ochre wearing a single small painted crescent moon.
Bursts a flock of tiny painted starlings off a snow-loaded rooftop, twenty birds mid-scatter in a black explosion of wings, the snow they dislodged still falling in a curtain below the eave.

Turns a ferris wheel mid-revolution, one painted rider at the very top in a vermillion gondola, a second gondola at the bottom just disgorging two painted figures onto the platform, the wheel's iron spokes still blurred with speed.
Spins a carousel mid-turn, painted riders on horses the colour of old gold, the outermost horse caught mid-lunge with its carved mane horizontal, a child's scarlet mitten flying off behind it.

Blows a shutter open against a whitewashed wall, its cobalt-blue panels slapping the render, the lace curtain inside billowing outward like a pale flag, a terracotta flowerpot tipped on the sill below.

Whips washing off a line between two chimney stacks, a viridian sheet half-torn free and horizontal in the gust, one wooden peg still pinching its corner, three more pegs already scattered on the cobbles beneath.

Lifts a dragon the size of a cat off a warm chimney pot, its scales the deep amber of old copper, one hind claw still gripping the terracotta rim, a tiny curl of steam rising from the pot it has just vacated.

Props a painted baker at the shopfront, one arm raising a wide sage-green shutter, the other still gripping a tray of small golden loaves, the fascia band above the windows painted plain ivory wearing a single small painted sheaf of wheat.

Halts a level-crossing gate mid-swing across the road, a painted stationmaster's arm still on the lever, a painted cyclist braking hard on the far side, the parallel iron rails still humming with the train that has just passed.

Plunges a scarlet locomotive mid-tunnel, its lit amber windows strobing the tunnel walls in warm bands, the white plume of its stack still curling at the tunnel mouth behind, its tender one plain block of painted black wearing a single small painted star.

Crests a painted caravan at the dune's ridge, two painted figures bracing the driver's bench against the tilt, the left wheel half off the crest, the long snake of wheel-ruts visible all the way down the gold-ochre slope behind, its canvas sides one plain block of painted saffron wearing a single small painted sun.
Leaps a painted dog mid-arc after a thrown stick, the stick still tumbling at the top of its arc, four paws off the snow, the take-off pit still fresh and dark in the white behind it.

Hangs a tiny painted lamplighter mid-reach on a brass ladder, a paper lantern half-hooked onto a pine-green bough above, the unlit lanterns below it already glowing amber, a small puddle of melted snow on the step where the lantern rested a moment before.

Careens a buttercup-yellow sledge around the sharp bend of Cobblestone Hill, two painted figures leaning hard left, a long twin groove scored into the snow behind them and a scatter of dislodged icicles still tumbling ahead.

Swings a painted lamplighter's arm up toward the iron hook, the scarlet lantern half-hung and still tilting, the ladder trembling below him and a puddle of warm amber light already blooming on the cobbles beneath.

Kicks a painted skater mid-stride across the frozen millpond, one blade lifted, a long curved scratch arcing behind on the blue-white ice and a tumbled woollen hat spinning slowly in the wake of that heel.

Lifts a corn-yellow hot-air balloon envelope halfway to full, the painted balloon crew of three bracing against the guy-ropes, the wicker basket still tilted at forty-five degrees, its flanks and panels one plain block of tangerine-painted colour wearing a single small painted sun.

Pitches a painted fisherman's cobalt-hulled dory through the harbour mouth, its wake fanning white behind it, a net still bundled at the stern, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted cobalt wearing a single small painted fish.

Rounds a bend on the high hill road, a claret-red sleigh with its runners kicking a rooster-tail of snow, the painted driver leaning back on the reins and the fresh curved groove disappearing behind the pine trees, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted claret wearing a single small painted star.

Sweeps the lighthouse beam in a long gold arc over the ink-black bay, a painted keeper silhouetted in the lantern room doorway, the beam catching a crest of spray below and a bright smear of reflection already fading on the water behind.

Topples a toboggan pile-up at the foot of the lane, three painted figures in a tangle of emerald-green scarves, the toboggan nose-first in the drift, and the hill above marked with the long straight scar of their whole breathless run, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted forest-green wearing a single small painted bird.

Blurs a painted carousel mid-spin, the six tiny painted riders leaning outward, the copper horses caught between up and down, a child's dropped pomegranate-red mitten still describing a slow arc away from the nearest outstretched hand.

Catches a painted carol singer mid-note in the ring around the lamp post, six painted figures mouths open, sheet music fluttering from one raised hand, the snow around the lamp pressed flat by six sets of boot-prints arriving from six different directions.

Turns a painted ferris wheel one car past the top, a lone painted figure gripping the safety bar, the car swaying slightly, the whole iron wheel blazing with a string of amber bulbs and the mud of the loading platform churned with footprints below.

Bursts a flock of painted starlings off the steep orange roof-tiles, a dozen tiny painted birds mid-scatter in a dark green-black cloud, the tiles still trembling and a loose one sliding toward the gutter, one bird already two wingbeats ahead of the rest.

Pushes a painted rowboat clear of the ice shelf, a single painted oarsman leaning on a pole, the hull grinding the last blue ridge, a fan of cracked ice spreading behind it, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted slate-grey wearing a single small painted crescent moon.

Skids a painted postie's bicycle sideways on the glazed lane, one booted foot stamped to the cobbles, the canvas satchel swinging wide, a cascade of ivory envelopes already arcing free, its flanks and panels one plain block of painted pillar-box red wearing a single small painted boot.

Hauls a painted bellringer backward off the floor, the great verdigris bell already tipped past the horizontal above, both rope and ringer at full stretch, and the stone flags below still reverberating in a haze of ancient dust.

Crests a painted caravan over the amber sand-dune's lip, the canvas bowing in the gust, two painted drovers leaning into the climb, the deep twin ruts of the approach still visible down the far side of the dune, its flanks and panels one plain block of saffron-painted colour wearing a single small painted curl of gilt scrollwork.

Bangs a shutter wide open against a mustard-yellow plaster wall, the iron hinge at full recoil, a painted figure inside reaching for it from a lit window, a clay pot on the sill already rocking toward the edge.

Leaps a tawny painted dog after a thrown stick, the stick tumbling apex-high in the cold air, the dog's four paws clear of the snow and the pair of paw-prints showing where it launched from the drift behind.
Snaps washing off a high line between two chimneys, a violet sheet mid-whip, a painted figure below running with arms wide, one wooden peg already spinning away and the empty line still quivering.

Clears a painted train halfway into the mountain tunnel, five lit amber windows still visible ahead of the dark, the plume of pearl smoke pinned behind it, its flanks and panels one plain block of Brunswick-green wearing a single small painted sprig.

Swings a level-crossing gate exactly halfway, a painted stationmaster's arm still on the handle, the gate's counterweight lifting, a painted cyclist frozen mid-skid on the near side and the straight iron track gleaming into the distance beyond.

Lifts a small painted dragon the size of a cat from the top of a warm terracotta chimney, its copper-scaled wings half-open, one hind claw still hooked on the pot's rim and a curl of chimney smoke coiling between the spread pinions.

Probes a painted baker's arm through the half-raised saffron shutter, a brass-handled tray balanced in the free hand, the shutter pole not yet in its bracket and the bakery fascia band above the window one plain block of warm ochre wearing a single small painted loaf.

Winds a lit procession of six tiny painted figures up the steep lane, the leader already gone around the top bend, each figure carrying a cobalt lantern on a pole, the fresh boothole trail climbing in a wavering line behind the last of them.

Catches a painted snowball dead in the air between two painted figures, its white core still perfectly round and shedding the first faint halo of powder, the thrower's arm extended behind and the catcher's gloved hands just beginning to cup forward.

Swinging hard left on the iced hill road, a tiny painted sleigh kicks a bright fan of snow off its iron runners, the deep rut carved into the bend behind it and the valley lamp-post still ahead, its flanks and panels one plain block of cardinal-red wearing a single small painted golden star.

Mid-stride on the frozen millpond, a tiny painted skater in a peacock-blue coat drags one long silver scratch across the ice behind her, arms flung wide, the far bank rushing toward two painted figures waiting to receive her.

Tangled at the foot of the toboggan run, three tiny painted figures in scarlet, mustard and forest-green are mid-tumble, a pine-green toboggan nose-first in a drift above them and a loose wool hat still tracing an arc in the cold air.

Caught mid-flight between two tiny painted figures, a hard white snowball hangs over the courtyard, one painted thrower still in the follow-through, the other already ducking behind a low wall with arms up.

Winding up the lamp-lit hill road, a tiny painted procession in amber and crimson carries paper lanterns, the front of the column already curling round the high bend and out of sight, the tail still gathered at the lower gate.

Standing in a tight ring around a cobalt-blue lamp post, six tiny painted carol singers tilt their faces upward, the lamplight falling in a hard yellow cone over them, one singer two steps back still hurrying to close the ring.

Stretching on tiptoe from a wooden ladder, a tiny painted figure in a vermillion coat hooks a brass lantern onto the highest branch of a spruce, the lit lanterns already hung below swinging gently, the dark top branch waiting.

Swinging its white beam out across a wild indigo sea, a lighthouse catches a burst of spray flung off a black rock, the lit path of the beam stretching to the horizon and the dark water churned silver where it falls.

Nosing into the harbour on a rising wake, a tiny painted fishing boat in terracotta-red tilts its bow toward the stone quay, the wake spreading in a wide bright V behind it and a painted fisherman already reaching for the mooring rope, its flanks and panels one plain block of terracotta wearing a single small painted fish.

Straining against a frozen rowboat, two tiny painted figures in cobalt and ochre push from the ice with long poles, the hull cracking free of its white collar and the broken ice rim still rocking behind it, its flanks and panels one plain block of pale ochre wearing a single small painted star.

Half-swung across the snow-dusted level crossing, the candy-striped gate is caught mid-arc, a tiny painted stationmaster in navy leaning back on it to slow the descent, the empty track gleaming ahead and the distant amber signal already blinking.

Turning steadily with one scarlet gondola at its highest point, a ferris wheel lets a tiny painted figure inside lean out over the miniature rooftops below, the cab just past the apex and the long slow descent beginning.

Mid-spin on the village green, a carousel flares its gold-and-crimson canopy, painted horses frozen mid-gallop, a tiny painted figure on the outermost horse leaning into the centrifugal pull, one small mitten reaching toward nothing.

Halfway up a sooty brick chimney on a tall ladder, a tiny painted chimney sweep in a soot-black coat braces one boot against the stack, the long brush handle extending up into the pot above and the ladder foot still wedged on the snow-packed tiles below.
Blown open and hanging at a wild angle, a sage-green shutter bangs against the ochre plaster wall, the latch swinging free and the white curtain inside already billowing outward into the cold.

Snapping off the line in a hard gust, three brilliant articles of washing — a scarlet nightgown, a gold tablecloth, a sky-blue apron — whip out over the alley, one corner of the apron still pegged and the rest cracking like a flag.

Heaving on the burner rope as the great saffron-yellow envelope billows half-inflated above the wicker basket, two tiny painted figures in rust-orange lean back against the tether, the shadow of the envelope already swelling dark across the snow beneath them, its flanks and panels one plain block of saffron wearing a single small painted bird.

Cresting the amber dune at the snowfield's edge, a tiny painted caravan in persimmon-red tilts its front wheels over the lip, the deep parallel tracks scoring the slope behind it and the painted driver in emerald-green already bracing forward, its flanks and panels one plain block of persimmon wearing a single small painted curl of gilt scrollwork.

Mid-leap after a thrown stick that is still a hand's-length ahead in the bright air, a tiny painted dog in amber-and-white clears a low snowdrift, all four paws off the ground and the paw-prints leading up to the jump stretched out behind in the soft white.

Leaning his full painted weight into a thick rope, a tiny bellringer in a cobalt coat pulls the great copper bell already tipped past its tipping point above the open arch, the rope taut and singing and the stone floor below worn bright where a thousand pulls have polished it.
